scenes.headline: How a relation model works without object labels
scenes.sub: RelateAnything: a 53M-parameter head that scores pairs against any list of predicates.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Wisteria! RelateAnything says how things in a picture relate: riding, holding, behind. And it never sees an object label.

scenes.text: Hand the predicate vocabulary in at inference as a list of strings. Nothing on the text side is learned, so swapping it is a matrix substitution.
scenes.say: The idea: hand in the list of relations at inference, as plain strings. Nothing on the text side is learned, so swapping the list is just a new matrix.

scenes.title: Pixels and boxes in, relations out

steps.say: Regions come from any detector or segmenter. A fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone reads the pixels, one query per box.
Each ordered pair gets five pooled features, and a relation transformer refines a hundred and twenty-eight pairs.
Separately, and once, the predicate strings pass through a frozen text encoder into a bank of embeddings.
Every pair is scored by cosine against every row of that bank. No object label enters anywhere.

scenes.title: Two views of a pair, mixed per predicate

parts.note: a geometry-led query against predicate e
an appearance-led query against the same predicate
a gate reads the mix from the predicate string alone
parts.say: A gate reads the mix from the string alone, so behind leans on geometry, and riding on appearance, even for strings it's never seen.

scenes.label: AUC at which the shipped routing buffer separates a corpus spatial flag
scenes.note: the gate called unsupervised is warm-started by a probe on that flag
scenes.say: One caveat. The paper calls that gate unsupervised, but it starts from a probe fitted to a spatial flag, and the shipped buffer still separates that flag perfectly.

scenes.text: Put the predicate list in as an input, not a weight, and relation prediction goes taxonomy-free, like detection before it.

recap: Regions from anywhere, never an object label
Pairs scored by cosine against a text bank
A gate mixes geometry and appearance
scenes.say: To recap: regions from anywhere, pairs scored against a swappable text bank, and a gate that mixes geometry with appearance.
